_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: move, draw, sprite allocator, art wait ($CBE8-$CFC3). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): move and draw (`$CBE8`, slot `$C08D`)
regions.description: Object X's drawing flags `$0620`: **bit 0 moves it in y (`$CC88`), bit 1 in x (`$CCEB`)**, then on into the draw. Carry set on return = the object left the screen.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): draw (`$CBFC`, slot `$C090`): the position
MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): draw: the attributes
regions.description: `$86` := the attribute byte `$0560`; **flag bit 2 flips it vertically (bit 7) while the y speed is not negative, flag bit 3 flips it horizontally (bit 6) while the x speed is not negative**: the picture faces the way it moves.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): draw: the metasprite
regions.description: `$0548` = 0 draws nothing; otherwise the record pointer `$89:$88` from the split table (`$C28D` low bytes, `$C319` high) and `JSR $CC46`. Returns carry clear.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): draw a record (`$CC46`)
regions.description: Count 0 = nothing; **bit 7 = draw twice: first with the horizontal flip toggled (`$86` bit 6), then as it is** - a symmetric picture costs half the data;

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): draw a record: the sprites
regions.description: `$8F` := the count; the offset-table pointer `$8B:$8A` is read from bytes 1-2; `$8D` indexes the tiles, `$8E` the attributes (after the tiles), `$8C` the offsets; **one `JSR $CDD7` per sprite.**

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): move in y (`$CC88`)
regions.description: The fraction `$0758` += `$05C0`; y += `$05D8` (+ carry). **Going down it leaves at y >= `$D0` or on a carry; going up it leaves when y goes below 0.**

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): left the screen
regions.description: Drawing flags bit 4 clear: the two return addresses are dropped and `SEC / RTS` - the caller of `$C08D` sees carry set. **Bit 4 set: four return addresses are dropped (the handler is abandoned) and the object is removed (`$CCBF`)**: such objects come back via `$0740` where the handlers restore the type.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): remove an object (`$CCBF`, slot `$C048`)
regions.description: `$0740,X` := the type AND `$7F` (remembered); the type and every movement and picture field zeroed.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): move in x (`$CCEB`)
regions.description: The fraction `$0770` += `$05F0`; x += `$0608` (+ carry); leaving at 0 or 255 (a carry going right, none going left).

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): y spring (`$CD12`, slot `$C09C`)
regions.description: A = the acceleration: the 16-bit y speed (`$05D8:$05C0`) is raised by A when y is under the target `$0668`, lowered when over, unchanged at equal. **A constant acceleration, not a spring in proportion to the distance.**

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): x spring (`$CD46`, slot `$C09F`)
regions.description: The same for x toward `$0680`, speed `$0608:$05F0`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): phase counter (`$CD7A`, slot `$C0A5`)
regions.description: `$0650` += A; on a carry `$0638` += 1, wrapping to 0 when it reaches Y; returns Y = the phase.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): clear the phase (`$CD99`, slot `$C0A2`)
MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): sprite allocator reset (`$CDA2`)
regions.description: All sprites hidden, `$83` bit 0 cleared, `$82` := 4, `$81` := `$FC`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): begin the frame's sprites (`$CDB4`, slot `$C096`)
regions.description: `$83` AND `$7D` (bits 1 and 7 cleared). **Bit 0 clear (an upward frame): `$80` := 4 and return. Set (downward): `$80` := (`$82` - 4)** (the wrap when `$82` is 4 sets bit 7 first).

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): emit one sprite (`$CDD7`)
regions.description: Unless the allocator is full (`$83` bit 1): X := `$80` (the OAM offset); `$F8` is stored as y first; the attribute := (`$86` AND `$E3`) EOR the record's attribute byte; the tile := the record's tile + the base `$87` (`$FF` = skip this sprite);

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): next sprite of the record
regions.description: `$8C` += 2 (the offset pair), `$8D` += 1 (the tile), and `$8E` += 1 only when the attribute byte's bit 3 is clear - **the attributes are run-length coded**: a set bit 3 reuses the attribute for the next sprite. Then `RTS`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): x offset, negative case
regions.description: The x offset (mirrored: negated and biased by 7) plus the object's x; a carry/borrow means off the screen: skip.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): the y offset
regions.description: The next offset byte, negated and biased by 15 when `$86` bit 7 (vertical flip) is set, added to the object's y; leaving the screen skips the sprite.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): store y and count
regions.description: y into OAM; `$8C` += 2, `$8D` += 1, `$8E` += 1 unless the attribute byte had bit 3.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): advance the allocator
regions.description: Bit 0 clear (upward): `$80` += 4, and a wrap to 0 sets bits 1 and 7 (full, wrapped: `$CE69`). Bit 0 set (downward): `$80` -= 4; under 4 it sets bit 7 and `$80` := `$FC`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): restore X
regions.description: `LDX $38 / RTS`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): finish the frame's sprites (`$CE88`, slot `$C099`)
regions.description: Bit 0 set (a downward frame) goes to `$CEDC`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): finish, upward frame
regions.description: X := `$80`; `$83` bit 7 (wrapped) set: A := 0 and on to `$CEC5`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): finish: hide the stale sprites
regions.description: The sprites left from earlier frames are hidden (y := `$F8`): those from `$80` up to `$82` (the end of the last upward block), then from the larger of that point and `$81` (the start of the last downward block) to the end of OAM (`$CEB8`).

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): finish: hide the rest
regions.description: `$F8` into every y from X up to the end of OAM.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): finish: remember where this block ended, and whether to flip
regions.description: `$82` := `$80`. `$83` AND `$84`: neither bit 7 (wrapped) nor bit 2 set flips the direction (`$CEFE`); bit 7 set flips; **bit 2 only (the normal case, bit 2 is set at start-up) flips only if the PPU's sprite-overflow flag `$26` bit 5 is set; otherwise `$81` := `$FC` and the frame stays upward.** So a calm frame never flips.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): finish, downward frame
regions.description: Wrapped (bit 7): `$81` := `$80`. Otherwise sprites from 4 to `$80` are hidden and `$81` := `$FC`.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): flip the direction (`$CEFE`)
regions.description: `$83` bit 0 toggled and return. Reached from the upward finish only when the frame ran out of OAM or overflowed, and from every downward frame (which turns the next frame upward again).

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): draw a single sprite (`$CF05`, slot `$C0DB`)
regions.description: One hardware sprite from `$84` (y), `$85` (x), `$86` (attribute), `$87` (tile), placed at `$80` and counted like a record's sprite (the tail at `$CE5B`).

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): the art block of a type (`$CF4C`)
regions.description: A = a type: under `$0E` returns 0; else `$CFB6[type]`, and if that has bit 7 the object's own `$07B8,X` is used.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): the art wait (`$CF5F`, slot `$C0A8`; `$CF68`, slot `$C0AB`, with the block in A)
regions.description: **The 16 slots `$0480-$048F` are searched for the type's block** (`$CFB6[type]`). Found: `$CF8D`. Not found: `$0758` counts down, and when it wraps `$0770` counts down too; at `$FD` the object is removed (**3 x 256 = 768 frames**); every call drops its caller's return address, so the handler waits undrawn.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): the block is loaded
regions.description: The counters cleared; `$06C8,X` and `$07E8,X` := the tile base `$0490[slot]` of the block's load slot.

regions.name: MOVE, DRAW, SPRITES AND THE ART WAIT (bank 7 `$CBE8-$CFC3`): load the type's stats (`$CFA0`, slot `$C0AE`)
regions.description: The type's bit 7 set (initialised); **`$0578` := `$D02C[type]` (collision flags), `$0590` := `$D0AB` (hit points), `$05A8` := `$D12A` (attack), `$0620` := `$D1A9` (drawing flags)**.
